question: which context tokens does the V-JEPA 2 predictor read motion direction from, by encoder depth?

hypothesis.text: we hypothesize it may be related to feature object binding, in which velocity information is most "bound" to the corresponding object. At the end of the network, information is catered to the optimization objective of predicting the next frame in latent space

prediction_if_true: obj (disk) fraction high at points 8-12 and falling by 22 while the bg fraction rises

definitions.binding_fraction: per pair <v_c - v_A, v_B - v_A> / ||v_B - v_A||^2, v = the reader probe's (sin, cos) output; mean over pairs with pair-bootstrap 95% CI (1 = patch moves the readout all the way to B, 0 = no move)
definitions.ratio_of_means: mean_pairs <v_c - v_A, u> / mean_pairs <v_B - v_A, u>, u = (v_B - v_A)/||v_B - v_A|| (Delta_c / Delta_all)
definitions.angle_fraction: signed move of the read angle from A's read angle along the shorter arc to B's, over the arc
definitions.err_to_A / err_to_B: circular |read angle - true theta of A / of B| (deg)

token_sets.obj: disk(A) | disk(B), + 1-patch ring (3x3 dilation per tubelet)
token_sets.objA: disk(A) + ring only (the literal design; B's disk tokens stay in bgA)
token_sets.all: B unpatched (patching every token = B's forward)

definitions.zone: paper's physics emergence zone = middle third, points 8-16; our per-patch onset points 8-9

pair_rule.same: motion type and magnitude (speed or acceleration value)
pair_rule.clips: knot + test roles (probe role held out for the probes)

forward.precision: bf16 autocast forward, fp32 residual stream, fp32 outputs
